display.purpose: The one empty-state heading that names the folder or the state.

headline.purpose: Each question at the top of its turn; dir=auto for Arabic.

title.purpose: Modal titles and headings inside an answer.

wordmark.purpose: "Atlas" in the top bar, neutral ink, the only 700 weight.

body.purpose: Answer prose (max 75ch), suggested questions, composer text.

body-sm.purpose: Sidebar names, source rows, tables, trace, form labels, usage line.

label.purpose: Badges, source numbers, the Sources heading, sheet letters and row numbers; sentence case.

mono.purpose: SQL and tool input in the trace only.

shadows.name: xs / page
shadows.purpose: The rendered PDF page on the viewer stage.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Theme step; not used directly by app components.

shadows.name: lg / modal
shadows.purpose: Source viewer and confirmation modals, over a 32% overlay.

shadows.name: xl
shadows.purpose: Theme step; not used directly by app components.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Theme motion token: finished parts fade and rise (4px turns, 2px register rows), collapses, AppShell and modal transitions, trace chevron.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on rows, quiet controls and the composer focus border; tooltips fade at 150ms.

motion.name: caret-pulse
motion.purpose: The streaming ink caret; static under reduced motion.

motion.name: avatar-loop
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame; pose eases with a 110ms half-life, the mouth with 45ms
motion.purpose: The call avatar only, while a call is open (The Living Face Rule). Paused in a hidden tab; a still pose per state under reduced motion.

motion.name: avatar-blink
motion.value: 180ms (70ms close, 110ms open), every 2.8 to 6.5s, sometimes a quick second blink
motion.purpose: Call avatar blinks while its eyes are open.

motion.name: avatar-breath
motion.value: 4.2s sine, 0.7 units of rise in a 120-unit drawing
motion.purpose: Call avatar breath for the whole open call.

motion.name: avatar-ring-turn
motion.purpose: The dashed ring while the call connects and while a spoken question runs; no animation under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Below it a source place always drops under its name; the call avatar drops to 56px with heavier lines, call controls grow to 40px with End call icon-only, and only the latest caption shows.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the sidebar collapses behind a burger and the cost pair moves to the composer hint line.

narrative.overview:
Atlas is the category standard for chat-with-your-documents tools, built to the craft of Claude.ai's calm reading column, Perplexity's numbered sources and Linear's dense, quiet chrome. The owner chose the conventions on purpose and the build doesn't dress them up. A near-white page holds one 760px conversation column. A slightly cooler neutral frames it: a 52px top bar and a 300px document register on the left. Everything is drawn with 1px hairlines on flat grounds. The one ink blue appears only where the reader acts or where the system points at evidence.

Density follows Linear more than a marketing page. Sidebar rows are 13px names over 12px meta. Tables run at 13px with tabular figures. The answer reads at 15px with a 75ch measure. Every number lines up digit under digit (register meta, result tables, source places, usage line, sheet row numbers). Motion only marks state changes: a hover tint, a chevron turning, and the finished answer's table and sources settling in once with a short fade-and-rise. One exception, approved by the owner on 2026-10-29: during a voice call, Atlas's face (a philosopher's bust in graphite line work) moves continuously, and nothing else does.

The system refuses the demo look named in the direction contract: gradients, glowing AI sparkles, bubble chat and cards inside cards. The question is a heading-weight line, not a bubble. The answer is plain prose on the page ground, not a card.
keyCharacteristics: One brand hue (deep ink blue, shade 7 of a 10-step ramp) for actions, focus, selection, links, citations, the streaming caret and the call avatar's ring while Atlas speaks
Two neutral grounds: near-white page and cooler chrome
1px hairline borders instead of shadows on every resting surface
One system UI family for everything (Segoe UI carries Arabic on Windows); monospace only for SQL and tool input
Logical properties throughout, so Arabic answers, quotes and arrows mirror correctly
Continuous motion lives only in the call avatar, and only while a call is open

rules.name: The Ink Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Ink blue marks only what you can act on and where an answer points (primary action, focus, link, selection, active citation, cited text, streaming caret, and the call avatar's ring while Atlas speaks). The wordmark, headings, icons and the drawing of the bust stay neutral.

rules.name: The Colour Means Trouble Rule
rules.body: Amber and red mean a file or request has a problem, nothing else. Document types and the ok state use neutral badges, empty and skipped files use gray, and "not found" answers use a neutral notice.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every place a number appears sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Numeric table columns align right and never wrap.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and badges are sentence case at zero tracking. The build has no uppercase or letterspaced text.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface that sits in the page gets a 1px border and no shadow. A shadow means the surface floats above the page.

rules.name: The Living Face Rule
rules.body: Continuous motion is allowed inside the call avatar only, and only while a call is open: blinks every 2.8 to 6.5s, a slow 4.2s breath, brows up while the user speaks, eyes up while a question runs, the mouth following Atlas's measured voice, and the ring dashed and turning while the call connects and while it checks. Under reduced motion it holds one still pose per state, and it does not move in a hidden tab. Every other surface keeps motion for state changes only.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius and shadow from the Mantine theme (`theme.ts`). Components carry no hex values.
Do keep ink blue to actions, focus, selection, links, citations, the streaming caret and the call avatar's speaking ring (The Ink Is Evidence Rule).
Do separate resting surfaces with 1px hairlines on page, chrome or white grounds, and keep shadows for modals, menus and the PDF page.
Do set every figure in tabular numerals and right-align numeric columns.
Do use logical properties (`inline-start`, `dir="auto"`, mirrored arrows) so Arabic content reads right to left.
Do use 150ms ease-out for hover and colour changes and 180ms `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for content settling in or collapsing, and disable both under reduced motion.
Do use Tabler outline icons at 1.5 to 2 stroke, sized 12 to 18px.
Do give the call avatar a still pose per state under reduced motion, and stop its motion in a hidden tab (The Living Face Rule).
donts: Don't use gradients, glowing AI sparkles, chat bubbles or cards inside cards.
Don't colour document types or ok files. Amber and red are for files and requests with problems only.
Don't put a shadow on a surface that sits in the page.
Don't set uppercase or letterspaced labels. Labels are sentence case at 12px/600.
Don't add a second typeface or a display face. Monospace is for SQL and tool input only.
Don't choreograph page loads. Motion marks state changes only, except inside the call avatar while a call is open.
Don't colour the bust. Its drawing stays graphite on white, and ink touches only its ring while Atlas speaks.
